# Results: Qwen3.8-27B on MR Gym by reinforcement learning, first runs

Files copied 2026-11-26T15:17:44Z. Some runs were still training then; their tables stop where the copied log stops.

**Status: exploratory.** These runs came before the plan of [PREREG-27b.md](PREREG-27b.md) could be followed as written; the deviations are listed in section 11. 4 training runs from the base model were read out on the secret split, each with one sampler seed; a cell holds 48 or 32 secret instances. The headline is run `v17`: the recipe of [RECIPE.md](../RECIPE.md) on the published code (commit `18089f2`). Read it as evidence that the model learns on the environment, not as the pre-registered result.

The model is trained by reinforcement learning only: LoRA (rank 32) with GRPO in verl on episodes played through the environment's tools, reward 1 when the delivered result passes the verifier and 0 otherwise. No demonstrations, no supervised step, no reference answers. Thinking is off and a reply holds at most 2,048 tokens, because an episode has to fit one accelerator as a single token stream (section 9).

What the tables show, and what they do not:

- The trained level (NoWrap-v1 L1) gains on instances the model never saw in 4 of 4 runs: +33.3 [+22.0, +44.7] (`v17`), +57.3 [+46.9, +67.7] (`v07`), +53.1 [+38.0, +68.3] (`v09`), +44.8 [+33.5, +56.1] (`v11`). Every interval lies above zero.
- The harder level (NoWrap-v1 L2): +16.7 [+7.0, +26.3] (`v17`), +35.4 [+23.8, +47.0] (`v07`), +9.4 [+0.9, +17.9] (`v09`) where it was a training cell; +12.5 [+4.9, +20.1] (`v11`) where it was not. Its reward appears late (section 8).
- NullTissue-v0 L0, the practice level of another task family (its text states the method): +43.8 [+31.5, +56.0] (`v17`), +35.4 [+21.1, +49.8] (`v07`) in the runs that never trained on it; +1.6 [-11.0, +14.1] (`v09`), -9.4 [-20.8, +2.1] (`v11`) in the runs that did (section 4). What carried over in the first case is executing a stated method through the tools. No conversation of these episodes has been read, so the mechanism is not established.
- NoWrap-v1 L3, never trained on: +4.2 [-0.9, +9.2] (`v17`), +4.2 [+0.1, +8.2] (`v07`), +3.1 [-1.3, +7.6] (`v09`). It is at the edge of its intervals and is not claimed.
- By the rule of the pre-registration (2 trained environments with a gain of at least 15 points and a lower bound above 5) each of the 4 runs trained 1 environment that meets it: "improved on one environment" 4 times, not the plan's "it trained".

- The accounting was corrected afterwards (commit `852d3b3`): until then a call that the instrument refused counted toward the rejected-call limit like a call that was written wrongly; since then only a call that is written wrongly does. Run `v19` trained NullTissue-v0 levels 0, 1 on that code (section 5); it has no readout.

### Run `v07`: the first result

Trained on NoWrap-v1 L1 and NoWrap-v1 L2 on 8 x H100 with a 32,768-token episode limit. Its weights after 40 and after 60 steps were evaluated against the base model by evaluation-only runs on a 57,344-token limit (runs `v12`, `v15`; the base half is shared).

## 10. What reading the conversations found

Four reads of about 250 stored conversations of `c04` against the verifiers: [NoWrap levels 2-3](27b/reads/nowrap_l2_l3.md), [PhantomQA](27b/reads/phantomqa.md), [NullTissue, T1Transmit, BandFree, ProtocolToSpec](27b/reads/fitting_families.md), [SNRSpec, FatSuppress, ArtefactClinic](27b/reads/snrspec_fatsuppress_clinic.md). They were written against the code before the corrections; paths in them are relative to the run folders.

- No scoring defect was found in any verifier (near misses recomputed by hand and re-scored).
- Defects of the environment, all corrected before `c05`: the calculator stopped legitimate fitting programs at a step limit, refused to print a non-finite number, and gave list `+` and `*` a meaning other than Python's; the statements never said that the agent's own scans may use any protocol; `plan` printed the image size in the reverse axis order and called a geometry that is never scanned "over budget"; `profile` clipped silently; ArtefactClinic-v0 instances depended on what other threads of the process were building.
- What remains is method: without the hint the model looks at the object with the slow target sequence, probes at the target repetition time, or never measures the transmit field.
- An episode limit that is too small hides learning: on the 32,768-token limit level 2 looked dead in `v07`, on the 57,344-token limit the same weights pass it (sections 6 and 7).

## 11. Deviations from the pre-registration

- Thinking off and 2,048-token replies instead of the planned reasoning setting: with reasoning an episode does not fit one accelerator.
- Trained environments that meet the rule, per run: 1 (`v17`), 1 (`v07`), 1 (`v09`), 1 (`v11`); the plan requires 2 for "it trained" (section 2).
- The readout cells of `v07` did not fit the episode limit of its node and its own readout stopped on its length check; the readout was made by separate evaluation-only runs on a larger limit, with the same instances and harness.
- The readout of `v09` stopped on its length check as well (152 of its 512 trained episodes were cut, 30 %); its two evaluation logs are complete and the paired readout here is computed from them.
- The secret split was read 7 times with trained weights (`v07` after 40 and 60 steps, `v13` after 80 and 110 steps, `v17` after 60, `v09` after 48, `v11` after 60) and 4 times with the base model; every reading is in this report. Where an evaluation log holds more than one attempt (the base log of `v09`: 2), the newest is used, as the readout of the node scripts does.
- The adapter of `v07` and `v13` was read 5 times on the same secret instances, the base model's reading included; the checkpoint of step 80 was chosen on the dev looks, the other steps were fixed (section 3).
- 48 or 32 secret instances per cell instead of the planned number; one sampler seed per run.
- `v11` ran on `6ced347` with the calculator's step limit raised to 5 million (interim, not merged).
- The evaluation table pools repeated looks at the same weights after a restart; the table the job itself printed kept the newer look only.

## 12. Limits

- 4 training runs from the base model have a readout. They differ in code, cells and node; none repeats another with a second sampler seed.
- The public dev split overstated the trained level in `v17`: its dev look at step 60 gave 62 / 64 (97 %), the secret split 79 / 96 (82 %). The secret-split figure is the one to quote.
- The gain on NullTissue-v0 is on its practice level, whose text states the method. The level without that text was read in 2 runs: 0 / 64 -> 0 / 64 (`v09`), 1 / 96 -> 0 / 96 (`v11`).
- Training can make a cell worse while the pass-rate rule reports no harm (section 4).
- All tasks of the suite are measurement tasks by the suite's own open-loop control; nothing here is evidence about decision tasks.
- 5 of the 9 scored families have every cell below 2 % for the thinking-off model in `c05`: the reward has nothing to start from there.
- The step-80 reading of the adapter line is of a checkpoint selected on the dev looks; it is not a fixed-step result (section 3).
- A second family did not train: NullTissue-v0 was a training cell in 4 runs (section 5).
- No conversation of a readout episode has been read: the report counts how episodes ended, it does not explain why.

## 13. Reproduce

```
python docs/experiments/27b/report.py --check          # this report from the stored files
python -m mrgym_verl.readout --base <test_base.jsonl> --trained <test_trained.jsonl> --untrained Scanner/NullTissue-v0 --min-envs 2
bash integrations/verl/node/make_main.sh train <settings.env> <job.sh>   # the node script of a run; settings in runs.json
```

The steps with one settings file, what a run costs and the pitfalls: [RECIPE.md](../RECIPE.md).
